intro: The Wardrobe H1 is designed for families who need both space and security. With thoughtful features like hanging rods, and ultra-secure locks, it offers elegance and functionality to elevate your home.

features.title: Anti-corrosive oven baked powder coating
features.text: Built to last, this wardrobe’s durable coating resists wear, ensuring a sleek, long-lasting finish while protecting your belongings from corrosion.

features.title: Effortless storage, perfect order
features.text: With ample hanging space and adjustable shelves, this wardrobe offers flexible storage, perfect for storing everything from jackets to accessories in an organised manner.

features.title: Locked for ultimate protection
features.text: Your belongings deserve the best protection. The advanced Ultra EXS lock features a unique dimple key, offering unmatched security with 10 crore combinations and tough, tamper-resistant features.

features.title: Battery operated motion sensor led light
features.text: Illuminate your wardrobe effortlessly with the battery-operated motion sensor LED light. It activates as you open the doors, making it easy to see your clothes, even in the dark.

features.title: Versatile storage for all your needs
features.text: Optimise your storage with dual hanging rods and adjustable shelves, giving you a tailored solution to store everything neatly while keeping your wardrobe organised and accessible.

name: Wardrobe H1 2-Door Steel Almirah Tex Shellwine Red
